# Orders and exits

Words that place entries and exits. Order words are statements, so they have no return value. PowerBridge fills them in its own fill engine; see the usage guide (docs/USAGE.md) for the fill model.

[Back to the keyword reference index](README.md)

### Buy

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | 0 or more | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

Opens or adds to a long position. Any open short is closed first, so a Buy while short reverses the position.

```easylanguage
If Close > Open Then Buy ("LE") Next Bar At Market;
```

### BuyToCover

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | 0 or more | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Closes all or part of a short position without opening a long. `Buy To Cover` written as two words is the same order.

```easylanguage
If MarketPosition = -1 and Close > Open Then BuyToCover ("SX") Next Bar At Market;
```

### Cover

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | none (used as a value) | not established | PowerBridge test (`tests/test_el_abbreviations.py`) | no | runs |

Only meaningful as the last word of `Buy To Cover`. PowerBridge reads the phrase as `BuyToCover`; `Cover` alone is not an order.

```easylanguage
If MarketPosition = -1 Then Buy To Cover ("SX") Next Bar At Market;
```

### IntraBarOrderGeneration

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | none (used as a value) | not established | PowerBridge test (`tests/test_ast_retention.py`) | no | transpiles; the run stops (not implemented in the runtime) |

Strategy setting for evaluating orders inside a bar rather than once at its close. PowerBridge evaluates once per bar and does not implement this setting; a run that reads it stops with an error.

### SameExitFromOneEntryOnce

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | transpiles; the run stops (not implemented in the runtime) |

A strategy setting that limits how often one named exit may fire against the same entry. PowerBridge's runtime does not implement it; a run that reaches it stops with an error.

### Sell

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | 0 or more | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

Closes all or part of a long position. It never opens a short; use `SellShort` for that.

```easylanguage
If MarketPosition = 1 and Close < Open Then Sell ("LX") Next Bar At Market;
```

### SellShort

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | at least 1 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

Opens or adds to a short position, reversing any open long. `Sell Short` written as two words means the same.

```easylanguage
If Close < Open Then SellShort ("SE") Next Bar At Market;
```

### SetBreakEven

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | at least 1 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

Once the open profit has reached the given money amount, places a stop at the entry price so the trade cannot turn into a loss.

```easylanguage
SetBreakEven(300);
If MarketPosition = 0 Then Buy Next Bar At Market;
```

### SetBreakEven_pt

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | at least 1 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Like `SetBreakEven`, with the trigger given in points of open profit per contract.

```easylanguage
SetBreakEven_pt(5);
If MarketPosition = 0 Then Buy Next Bar At Market;
```

### SetDollarTrailing

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | at least 1 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

Trails a stop the given money amount behind the best open profit reached so far in the position.

```easylanguage
SetDollarTrailing(400);
If MarketPosition = 0 Then Buy Next Bar At Market;
```

### SetExitOnClose

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

Closes any open position at the close of the last bar of each session.

```easylanguage
SetExitOnClose;
If MarketPosition = 0 Then Buy Next Bar At Market;
```

### SetPercentTrailing

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | at least 2 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

Takes two arguments: a profit threshold in money and a percentage. After the threshold is reached, the position is closed if it gives back that percentage of its peak profit.

```easylanguage
SetPercentTrailing(500, 30);
If MarketPosition = 0 Then Buy Next Bar At Market;
```

### SetPercentTrailing_pt

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | at least 2 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Like `SetPercentTrailing`, with the profit threshold given in points instead of money.

```easylanguage
SetPercentTrailing_pt(10, 25);
If MarketPosition = 0 Then Buy Next Bar At Market;
```

### SetProfitTarget

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | at least 1 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | at least 1 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

### SetStopContract

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

Asks for the money amounts of the built-in exits to apply per contract instead of to the whole position. PowerBridge accepts it but does not yet honour it: its fill engine still applies the amounts to the whole position, so trades match `SetStopPosition`.

```easylanguage
SetStopContract;
SetStopLoss(250);
If MarketPosition = 0 Then Buy Next Bar At Market;
```

### SetStopLoss

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | at least 1 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

Sets a protective stop for the open position, given as a money loss. PowerBridge always applies the amount to the whole position (the `SetStopPosition` mode).

```easylanguage
SetStopPosition;
SetStopLoss(500);
If MarketPosition = 0 Then Buy Next Bar At Market;
```

### SetStopLoss_pt

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | at least 1 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

Like `SetStopLoss`, but the distance is given in points (price units) from the entry price instead of in money.

```easylanguage
SetStopLoss_pt(10);
If MarketPosition = 0 Then Buy Next Bar At Market;
```

### SetStopPosition

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

Makes the money amounts of the built-in exits (`SetStopLoss`, `SetProfitTarget` and the rest) apply to the whole position. This is the default.

```easylanguage
SetStopPosition;
SetStopLoss(800);
If MarketPosition = 0 Then Buy Next Bar At Market;
```

### SetStopShare

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | none (used as a value) | not established | capture (strategy-level) | no | runs |

Equity-market spelling of `SetStopContract`. Like it, PowerBridge accepts it but still applies the exit amounts to the whole position.

```easylanguage

```

### SetTrailingStop_pt

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | at least 1 | not established | capture (strategy-level) | yes | runs |

### Short

| Kind | Returns | Arguments | Argument types | Evidence | On MC compile list | Run status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| builtin | none / not established | none (used as a value) | not established | PowerBridge test (`tests/test_el_abbreviations.py`) | no | runs |
